findings.title: Java MessageFormat/choice syntax used in an i18next-based UI message
findings.body: The account UI message 'error-invalid-multivalued-size' was changed from i18next-style interpolation ('{{0}}', '{{1}}', '{{2}}') to Java MessageFormat syntax ('{0}', '{2,choice,...}'). The surrounding account-ui messages still use '{{...}}' placeholders and react-i18next/Trans tags such as '<0>', so this value will not be formatted by the UI. Users will likely see the literal pattern, including the raw choice expression, instead of a localized validation message.

findings.title: Java MessageFormat/choice syntax used in an i18next-based admin UI message
findings.body: The admin UI message 'error-invalid-multivalued-size' was changed from i18next-style interpolation ('{{0}}', '{{1}}', '{{2}}') to Java MessageFormat syntax ('{0}', '{2,choice,...}'). Admin UI message resources generally use '{{...}}' interpolation, so this key will not be substituted or pluralized client-side. The UI will display the raw MessageFormat/choice pattern instead of a properly formatted error message.

findings.title: PropertyResourceBundle is constructed from an InputStream and will not read UTF-8 properties reliably
findings.body: verifySafeHtml() creates PropertyResourceBundle directly from FileInputStream for both the checked file and its English counterpart. PropertyResourceBundle(InputStream) uses the legacy ISO-8859-1 properties encoding, while Keycloak theme message files in this PR contain UTF-8 translated text. Non-ASCII message contents will be mangled before sanitization/comparison, which can cause false positives, false negatives, or confusing verifier diagnostics. Use an InputStreamReader with StandardCharsets.UTF_8 for both bundles.

findings.title: Lithuanian account message replaced with Italian text
findings.body: In the Lithuanian account messages file, 'totpStep1' is now 'Installa una delle seguenti applicazioni sul tuo cellulare:', which is Italian. The surrounding messages are Lithuanian, so Lithuanian users will see an Italian instruction line in the account UI/theme.

findings.title: Lithuanian login message replaced with Italian text
findings.body: In the Lithuanian login messages file, 'loginTotpStep1' is now 'Installa una delle seguenti applicazioni sul tuo cellulare:', which is Italian. The surrounding messages are Lithuanian, so Lithuanian users will see an Italian instruction line during login/OTP setup.

findings.title: Simplified Chinese account message uses Traditional Chinese characters
findings.body: The zh_CN account messages file sets 'totpStep1' to '在您的手機上安裝以下應用程式之一：', which uses Traditional Chinese characters. This file is for Simplified Chinese (zh_CN), while other entries in the same file use Simplified Chinese, so the text is inconsistent for the locale.

' tag, the user-visible Danish email text should also be corrected.

findings.title: HTML detection only matches lowercase tag names
findings.body:
HTML_TAGS is '<[a-z]+[^>]*>', so it only detects lowercase HTML tags. If an English source string contains HTML with uppercase or mixed-case tags such as '
' or '', containsHtml() will return false and translations using the same tags will be rejected as illegal HTML even though the source string contains HTML. The tag detection should be case-insensitive or otherwise more robust.

findings.title: English companion file is derived by regex-replacing the whole absolute path
findings.body: englishFile is computed by applying replaceAll('resources-community', 'resources') and replaceAll('_[a-zA-Z-_]*\.properties', '_en.properties') to file.getAbsolutePath(). This can alter unrelated parts of a path if they contain those strings and assumes the locale suffix pattern appears only once at the end of the file name. It would be safer to resolve the sibling file name and replace only the final locale suffix of the file name.
